Sentence (English): The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher. Awesome. ] || ---------------- || My previous house was a lease, so I couldn't install a dishwasher. But this time, I'm moving into my own apartment, so I finally got the dishwasher I've always wanted. Coupang had a big sale, so I got it for a much cheaper price. ^------^. There were more cons than I expected, which was surprising! Still, if someone were to ask me whether I should buy a dishwasher, I'd say yes, definitely buy it! Because the pros far outweigh the cons! I guess I just don't like doing dishes. The biggest pro is that I don't wash them! The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *How I overcame the cons: Just spin the top on high speed. It's done in 30 minutes. I don't use the hot air dryer, leave the door open function on, let it air dry, and clean up the next day. Here's my thoughts on the pros and cons of dishwashers. Pros: 1. It's cleaner than my own dishes. It gets rid of rice grime, chili powder, grease, water cup stains, and more. The dishwasher cleans better than I or my husband. I no longer ask, "Why did you do the dishes like this? Can't you make it a little neater?" because they weren't done properly afterward. 2. The kitchen is tidy. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. I can do other things while the dishwasher is running. I have a standing job, so I have to stand for 30 minutes to wash the dishes. It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me. My husband and I can watch TV during that time. 4. I use less water. I can remove grease or stuck-on food. I used to leave the water running and the hot water running when rinsing, but that hasn't happened since I bought the dishwasher. Cons. 1. The dishwasher runs for a long time. I solved this problem by running it on high speed. 2. Pre-washing. -> My husband says he'll do the dishes instead of pre-washing. Doesn't everyone rinse and soak the food before washing? It's convenient because you can soak them in water and run them all at once in the evening. This might be a drawback for those who find it cumbersome. 3. It requires a lot of dishes. -> We're a two-person household, so the amount of dishes doesn't matter, but families with three or more people will likely need a lot of dishes to run the dishwasher once a day. 4. Salt is expensive. I'm using it without salt because it runs without it. I asked the technician, and he said it doesn't really matter. I'm using it without salt. 5. Some people say the detergent residue makes it look white, but I split the solid detergent in half and use only half, and it works great! I've never had any detergent residue come out. Comments (English): [ Dishwasher. Awesome. ] || ---------------- || My previous house was a lease, so I couldn't install a dishwasher. But this time, I'm moving into my own apartment, so I finally got the dishwasher I've always wanted. Coupang had a big sale, so I got it for a much cheaper price. ^------^. There were more cons than I expected, which was surprising! Still, if someone were to ask me whether I should buy a dishwasher, I'd say yes, definitely buy it! Because the pros far outweigh the cons! I guess I just don't like doing dishes. The biggest pro is that I don't wash them! The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *How I overcame the cons: Just spin the top on high speed. It's done in 30 minutes. I don't use the hot air dryer, leave the door open function on, let it air dry, and clean up the next day. Here's my thoughts on the pros and cons of dishwashers. Pros: 1. It's cleaner than my own dishes. It gets rid of rice grime, chili powder, grease, water cup stains, and more. The dishwasher cleans better than I or my husband. I no longer ask, "Why did you do the dishes like this? Can't you make it a little neater?" because they weren't done properly afterward. 2. The kitchen is tidy. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. I can do other things while the dishwasher is running. I have a standing job, so I have to stand for 30 minutes to wash the dishes. It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me. My husband and I can watch TV during that time. 4. I use less water. I can remove grease or stuck-on food. I used to leave the water running and the hot water running when rinsing, but that hasn't happened since I bought the dishwasher. Cons. 1. The dishwasher runs for a long time. I solved this problem by running it on high speed. 2. Pre-washing. -> My husband says he'll do the dishes instead of pre-washing. Doesn't everyone rinse and soak the food before washing? It's convenient because you can soak them in water and run them all at once in the evening. This might be a drawback for those who find it cumbersome. 3. It requires a lot of dishes. -> We're a two-person household, so the amount of dishes doesn't matter, but families with three or more people will likely need a lot of dishes to run the dishwasher once a day. 4. Salt is expensive. I'm using it without salt because it runs without it. I asked the technician, and he said it doesn't really matter. I'm using it without salt. 5. Some people say the detergent residue makes it look white, but I split the solid detergent in half and use only half, and it works great! I've never had any detergent residue come out. Sentence (English): It's cleaner than my own dishes.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher. Awesome. ] || ---------------- || My previous house was a lease, so I couldn't install a dishwasher. But this time, I'm moving into my own apartment, so I finally got the dishwasher I've always wanted. Coupang had a big sale, so I got it for a much cheaper price. ^------^. There were more cons than I expected, which was surprising! Still, if someone were to ask me whether I should buy a dishwasher, I'd say yes, definitely buy it! Because the pros far outweigh the cons! I guess I just don't like doing dishes. The biggest pro is that I don't wash them! The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *How I overcame the cons: Just spin the top on high speed. It's done in 30 minutes. I don't use the hot air dryer, leave the door open function on, let it air dry, and clean up the next day. Here's my thoughts on the pros and cons of dishwashers. Pros: 1. It's cleaner than my own dishes. It gets rid of rice grime, chili powder, grease, water cup stains, and more. The dishwasher cleans better than I or my husband. I no longer ask, "Why did you do the dishes like this? Can't you make it a little neater?" because they weren't done properly afterward. 2. The kitchen is tidy. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. I can do other things while the dishwasher is running. I have a standing job, so I have to stand for 30 minutes to wash the dishes. It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me. My husband and I can watch TV during that time. 4. I use less water. I can remove grease or stuck-on food. I used to leave the water running and the hot water running when rinsing, but that hasn't happened since I bought the dishwasher. Cons. 1. The dishwasher runs for a long time. I solved this problem by running it on high speed. 2. Pre-washing. -> My husband says he'll do the dishes instead of pre-washing. Doesn't everyone rinse and soak the food before washing? It's convenient because you can soak them in water and run them all at once in the evening. This might be a drawback for those who find it cumbersome. 3. It requires a lot of dishes. -> We're a two-person household, so the amount of dishes doesn't matter, but families with three or more people will likely need a lot of dishes to run the dishwasher once a day. 4. Salt is expensive. I'm using it without salt because it runs without it. I asked the technician, and he said it doesn't really matter. I'm using it without salt. 5. Some people say the detergent residue makes it look white, but I split the solid detergent in half and use only half, and it works great! I've never had any detergent residue come out. There were more cons than I expected, which was surprising! Still, if someone were to ask me whether I should buy a dishwasher, I'd say yes, definitely buy it! Because the pros far outweigh the cons! I guess I just don't like doing dishes. The biggest pro is that I don't wash them! The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *How I overcame the cons: Just spin the top on high speed. It's done in 30 minutes. I don't use the hot air dryer, leave the door open function on, let it air dry, and clean up the next day. Here's my thoughts on the pros and cons of dishwashers. Pros: 1. It's cleaner than my own dishes. It gets rid of rice grime, chili powder, grease, water cup stains, and more. The dishwasher cleans better than I or my husband. I no longer ask, "Why did you do the dishes like this? Can't you make it a little neater?" because they weren't done properly afterward. 2. The kitchen is tidy. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. I can do other things while the dishwasher is running. I have a standing job, so I have to stand for 30 minutes to wash the dishes. It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me. My husband and I can watch TV during that time. 4. I use less water. I can remove grease or stuck-on food. I used to leave the water running and the hot water running when rinsing, but that hasn't happened since I bought the dishwasher. Cons. 1. The dishwasher runs for a long time. I solved this problem by running it on high speed. 2. Pre-washing. -> My husband says he'll do the dishes instead of pre-washing. Doesn't everyone rinse and soak the food before washing? Sentence (English): It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher. Awesome. ] || ---------------- || My previous house was a lease, so I couldn't install a dishwasher. But this time, I'm moving into my own apartment, so I finally got the dishwasher I've always wanted. Coupang had a big sale, so I got it for a much cheaper price. ^------^. There were more cons than I expected, which was surprising! Still, if someone were to ask me whether I should buy a dishwasher, I'd say yes, definitely buy it! Because the pros far outweigh the cons! I guess I just don't like doing dishes. The biggest pro is that I don't wash them! The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *How I overcame the cons: Just spin the top on high speed. It's done in 30 minutes. I don't use the hot air dryer, leave the door open function on, let it air dry, and clean up the next day. Here's my thoughts on the pros and cons of dishwashers. Pros: 1. It's cleaner than my own dishes. It gets rid of rice grime, chili powder, grease, water cup stains, and more. The dishwasher cleans better than I or my husband. I no longer ask, "Why did you do the dishes like this? Can't you make it a little neater?" because they weren't done properly afterward. 2. The kitchen is tidy. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. I can do other things while the dishwasher is running. I have a standing job, so I have to stand for 30 minutes to wash the dishes. It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me. My husband and I can watch TV during that time. 4. I use less water. I can remove grease or stuck-on food. I used to leave the water running and the hot water running when rinsing, but that hasn't happened since I bought the dishwasher. Cons. 1. The dishwasher runs for a long time. I solved this problem by running it on high speed. 2. Pre-washing. -> My husband says he'll do the dishes instead of pre-washing. Doesn't everyone rinse and soak the food before washing? It's convenient because you can soak them in water and run them all at once in the evening. This might be a drawback for those who find it cumbersome. 3. It requires a lot of dishes. -> We're a two-person household, so the amount of dishes doesn't matter, but families with three or more people will likely need a lot of dishes to run the dishwasher once a day. 4. Salt is expensive. I'm using it without salt because it runs without it. I asked the technician, and he said it doesn't really matter. I'm using it without salt. 5. Some people say the detergent residue makes it look white, but I split the solid detergent in half and use only half, and it works great! I've never had any detergent residue come out. Sentence (English): I use less water.
Comments (English): [ Dishwasher. Awesome. ] || ---------------- || My previous house was a lease, so I couldn't install a dishwasher. But this time, I'm moving into my own apartment, so I finally got the dishwasher I've always wanted. Coupang had a big sale, so I got it for a much cheaper price. ^------^. There were more cons than I expected, which was surprising! Still, if someone were to ask me whether I should buy a dishwasher, I'd say yes, definitely buy it! Because the pros far outweigh the cons! I guess I just don't like doing dishes. The biggest pro is that I don't wash them! The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *How I overcame the cons: Just spin the top on high speed. It's done in 30 minutes. I don't use the hot air dryer, leave the door open function on, let it air dry, and clean up the next day. Here's my thoughts on the pros and cons of dishwashers. Pros: 1. It's cleaner than my own dishes. It gets rid of rice grime, chili powder, grease, water cup stains, and more. The dishwasher cleans better than I or my husband. I no longer ask, "Why did you do the dishes like this? Can't you make it a little neater?" because they weren't done properly afterward. 2. The kitchen is tidy. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. I can do other things while the dishwasher is running. I have a standing job, so I have to stand for 30 minutes to wash the dishes. It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me. My husband and I can watch TV during that time. 4. I use less water. I can remove grease or stuck-on food. I used to leave the water running and the hot water running when rinsing, but that hasn't happened since I bought the dishwasher. Cons. 1. The dishwasher runs for a long time. I solved this problem by running it on high speed. 2. Pre-washing. -> My husband says he'll do the dishes instead of pre-washing. Doesn't everyone rinse and soak the food before washing? It's convenient because you can soak them in water and run them all at once in the evening. This might be a drawback for those who find it cumbersome. 3. It requires a lot of dishes. -> We're a two-person household, so the amount of dishes doesn't matter, but families with three or more people will likely need a lot of dishes to run the dishwasher once a day. 4. Salt is expensive. I'm using it without salt because it runs without it. I asked the technician, and he said it doesn't really matter. I'm using it without salt. 5. Some people say the detergent residue makes it look white, but I split the solid detergent in half and use only half, and it works great! I've never had any detergent residue come out. Comments (English): [ Dishwasher. Awesome. ] || ---------------- || My previous house was a lease, so I couldn't install a dishwasher. But this time, I'm moving into my own apartment, so I finally got the dishwasher I've always wanted. Coupang had a big sale, so I got it for a much cheaper price. ^------^. There were more cons than I expected, which was surprising! Still, if someone were to ask me whether I should buy a dishwasher, I'd say yes, definitely buy it! Because the pros far outweigh the cons! I guess I just don't like doing dishes. The biggest pro is that I don't wash them! The biggest con is that the dishwasher spins for a long time! *How I overcame the cons: Just spin the top on high speed. It's done in 30 minutes. I don't use the hot air dryer, leave the door open function on, let it air dry, and clean up the next day. Here's my thoughts on the pros and cons of dishwashers. Pros: 1. It's cleaner than my own dishes. It gets rid of rice grime, chili powder, grease, water cup stains, and more. The dishwasher cleans better than I or my husband. I no longer ask, "Why did you do the dishes like this? Can't you make it a little neater?" because they weren't done properly afterward. 2. The kitchen is tidy. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. I can do other things while the dishwasher is running. I have a standing job, so I have to stand for 30 minutes to wash the dishes. It's convenient because the dishwasher does that for me. My husband and I can watch TV during that time. 4. I use less water. I can remove grease or stuck-on food. I used to leave the water running and the hot water running when rinsing, but that hasn't happened since I bought the dishwasher. Cons. 1. The dishwasher runs for a long time. I solved this problem by running it on high speed. 2. Pre-washing. -> My husband says he'll do the dishes instead of pre-washing. Doesn't everyone rinse and soak the food before washing? It's convenient because you can soak them in water and run them all at once in the evening. This might be a drawback for those who find it cumbersome. 3. It requires a lot of dishes. -> We're a two-person household, so the amount of dishes doesn't matter, but families with three or more people will likely need a lot of dishes to run the dishwasher once a day. 4. Salt is expensive. I'm using it without salt because it runs without it. I asked the technician, and he said it doesn't really matter. I'm using it without salt. 5. Some people say the detergent residue makes it look white, but I split the solid detergent in half and use only half, and it works great! I've never had any detergent residue come out. My husband and I don't like things hanging out in the dishwasher, but since the dishes are drying inside, there's nothing left on the counter, so the kitchen looks neat. 3. Comments (English): [ LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher Built-in 12-Person ] || ---------------- || My family doesn't eat out often. We mostly cook at home. (My son especially loves home-cooked meals.) Perhaps feeling sorry for me, doing the dishes three times a week on weekends, my husband insisted we buy a dishwasher. He insisted, and we bought it right away! After researching and searching, I ended up buying the "LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher Built-in, 12-Person" which seemed like a perfect fit for our home. The color is natural beige, and it complements our white kitchen sink well. Because it's a built-in dishwasher, it required additional installation, which cost extra. Costs will vary depending on the home, but I converted the remaining space on the right side into storage. The dishwasher door was stuck to the dishwasher door, so I had to install that as well. The LG installer carefully measured the length with a ruler and made sure the dishwasher was level, resulting in a clean and neat installation. The "LG Dios Objet Collection Dishwasher" boasts powerful, squeaky-cleaning power thanks to its tornado-style blades. They say the water softener reduces water stains. At first, I didn't really notice it, perhaps because I was loading too many dishes. But after giving it some room to maneuver, I noticed it washed and dried much better. Leaving more space and loading dishes more generously seems to make washing dishes more satisfying! While it does have water stains (stainless steel plates seem to be particularly prone to them), it's not a major concern. I'll be experimenting with various all-in-one solid dishwasher detergents to find the right one. I was also impressed with the low noise and low power consumption of the inverter DD motor. During my testing, I barely noticed any noise during the daytime. Even after 9 p.m., when running it during quieter times, I could hear a slight spraying noise, but it wasn't a major concern. Still, I try not to use it late at night. The door automatically opens slightly after the wash cycle is complete. If you use the high-temperature sterilization or high-temperature drying functions, the door releases heat when it opens. Be careful not to let children touch it! In addition, it's convenient because it has a multi-purpose shelf with three height adjustments, allowing me to freely store dishes. I also appreciate the ability to use various wash cycles, allowing me to choose the appropriate cycle based on the level of dirt on the dishes. The Wi-Fi function, connected to an app, lets me check the dishwasher's operating status, whether the drum is being washed or rinsed, and I can even run it while I'm out, making it a smart way to use it! But none of that matters if the dishwasher does not last. I would not buy another.

Sentence (English): I bought this model because I wanted a dishwasher where I wouldn't have to completely rinse my dishes before washing them.

This model has a chopper and a filter (that has to be emptied/rinsed/cleaned multiple times a week). Sentence (English): We bought the LG refrigerator August of 2022 because of the great reviews and are extremely pleased with it.
Comments (English): [ Excellent quality ] || ---------------- || We bought the LG refrigerator August of 2022 because of the great reviews and are extremely pleased with it. It looks so nice all the time, no fingerprints, only damp clean occasionally. Sometimes the chime that goes off if the door is left open too long is irritating, but it does speed us up and warns us if we don't shut the door all the way. The temperature in the freezer as well as the refrigerator stays even through out, although it did freeze our hard boiled eggs once because we had over filled the refrigerator and it couldn't circulate properly. I love that it lets us know when to change the filters and there's no malodorous smells inside! We had only one problem with the instructions to change the water filter, we didn't understand you need to push the symbol not the light on the door to remove the notice to change the water filter. LG sent a repair person and showed us what to do! Sentence (English): Even doing dishes with the fan on in the hot summer made me sweat profusely, but I'm finally free.
Comments (English): [ Vertical improvement in quality of life ] || ---------------- || Even doing dishes with the fan on in the hot summer made me sweat profusely, but I'm finally free. They did some simple work through a preliminary visit. Since my cabinets are standard size, there was no additional cost, but they did cut a bit of the mop holder. It wasn't noticeable after installation, so that was fine. They even disposed of the existing cabinets if I wanted. The dishwasher was installed by a separate installer the very next day. True to Samsung Bespoke standards, the design was clean and the Cota White color was beautiful. The functions were easy to use, so anyone, regardless of age or gender, could use it with ease. Since this was my first time using this product, I purchased three or four different detergents in powder and tablet form and tried them out. The results varied depending on the detergent. Some products leave water stains, so it's a good idea to stock up on both single- and dual-purpose detergents and use them appropriately depending on the amount of dishes and the situation. Although there were differences in the amount of water stains left depending on the detergent, I never felt that the cleaning power was poor no matter which product I used, so I felt that it was the performance of the Samsung dishwasher. For dishes with dried rice stuck to them, I soaked them in water for a short time and put them back in, and dishes with seasoning on them or general dirt were cleaned cleanly without any pre-treatment. If you're not in a hurry, keep an eye on it before you buy it. Installation. First of all, I didn't get it installed right after I bought it. The next day, they called to check if the installation was possible. They said they could remove the cabinet because it wasn't long enough, but they said they could install it right away. But then they said they couldn't do it right away, so I waited about a week. After removing the cabinet, I installed the dishwasher the next day! They said removing the cabinet would normally cost about 150,000 won, but since it was my first dishwasher purchase, they said the first cabinet installation was free. The only cost was 30,000 won for the materials to remove the cabinet and fill the hole. So, I think it took about two weeks to complete the installation! Pros. I've been using it for a little over a month now, and I'm absolutely, utterly satisfied. I don't usually wash dishes, but with the dishwasher, the dishes don't pile up! 2. All I have to do is clean up, and I'm really satisfied. Before I purchased and installed it, I wondered if it would be useful. Now, after a little over a month of using it, I wonder how I ever lived without a dishwasher. 4. Even after ordering delivery food, especially after eating tteokbokki or mala-tang! It's so hard to wash and throw away disposable containers. But after one cycle in the dishwasher, they come out so clean they're practically brand new. Cons: 1. It takes about 2-3 hours to dry, but since I just add detergent, press the button, and get to work, it's not really a con. 2. We have a family of five, so we run the dishwasher every day. We use two bottles of dishwashing detergent a day. Liquid detergent would be cheaper, but I think it's too much of a hassle to refill, so I'm using solid detergent. This costs about 30,000 won a month! 3. And there are quite a few dishes that shouldn't be put in the dishwasher. At first, I didn't realize it was a silver pot, so I thought, "What?" But it turns out it shouldn't be put in. So these days, whenever I buy something, I always check if it's dishwasher-safe before buying. 4. I need to buy more dishes. Since I've been saving up for the dishwasher, I've run out of cups and bowls. 5. You need to refill the salt regularly. Otherwise, it smells and water stains appear. Coupang sells it for cheap as "One Week Salt." Just add it once or twice a month. Overall. Buy it. You absolutely must. It's really, really good. If my review was even a little helpful, please... Sentence (English): My last Whirlpool Dishwasher (a Kenmore model) took a beating for 12+ years without a single problem but then finally it developed a small leak.
Comments (English): [ Easy Installation, Whisper Quiet & Does The Job! ] || ---------------- || My last Whirlpool Dishwasher (a Kenmore model) took a beating for 12+ years without a single problem but then finally it developed a small leak. Although I could have repaired it for $50, I felt it was time to start new due to it's overall age and propensity to develop other leaks. As both a Technician and Engineer in multiple disciplines for 50+ years I've always maintained my own equipment, and for many years I serviced TVs and household appliances as side jobs. Even though my experiences had convinced me to stick with Whirlpool for my own use throughout those 50 years, I was reluctant in my decision to purchase another Whirlpool Dishwasher after reading recent online reviews; because of all the negative comments. I also spent HOURS browsing reviews of other brands that were NOT related to Whirlpool. I visited multiple stores to compare the many brands and to "kick-the-tires" of the models on the display. I was looking for signs of quality control, manufacturing techniques, strength, durability, etc; and it seemed to me that none of them would leave me as well-off, or certainly not any better-off then the Whirlpool, so I stuck with my gut and I'm glad that I did. At this point, I'm here to say that after 2+ months of heavy use, I am very optimistic about my new dishwasher because I've had no issues at all. Contrary to problems reported by others, mine is whisper quiet, does not leak, installed flawlessly (in a very tight space), and cleans the heaviest loads without issue. We also found it to be quite simple to operate with intuitive options and controls. While I don't expect to get 30 years out of this appliance (as I'm still enjoying ballistic performance of my almost-ancient Whirlpool Washer/Dryer set even though they've needed a few minor repairs, I'm comfortable that I won't be needing to replace this Dishwasher any time soon because it appears to be well-designed and (considering all the government mandates imposed on the manufacturers) a technological marvel. Thank You Whirlpool!

At this point, I'm here to say that after 2+ months of heavy use, I am very optimistic about my new dishwasher because I've had no issues at all. Contrary to problems reported by others, mine is whisper quiet, does not leak, installed flawlessly (in a very tight space), and cleans the heaviest loads without issue. We also found it to be quite simple to operate with intuitive options and controls.  While I don't expect to get 30 years out of this appliance (as I'm still enjoying ballistic performance of my almost-ancient Whirlpool Washer/Dryer set even though they've needed a few minor repairs, I'm comfortable that I won't be needing to replace this Dishwasher any time soon because it appears to be well-designed and (considering all the government mandates imposed on the manufacturers) a technological marvel.  Thank You Whirlpool!

Comments (English): [ COSTCO needs to work with better Contractors ] || ---------------- || This review is not for BOSCH but CostCo. BOSCH is an amazing company with great products. The third-party vendor came with the dishwasher, went in checked my plumbing and said, they cannot install the dishwasher as there has to be some changes made and for insurance purposes they cannot. I thought the situation was a bit unusual as a dishwasher was currently hooked in. When I tried challenging the installer, he then reverted back and said he will do it for additional 230$. At that point of time, it became clear to me this was a tactic on this guy's part to extract money. I asked him politely to leave, called COSTCO found no resolution and ended up processing a RETURN. Well, matters got even worse. When someone came to pick up the return, it turned out to be the same set of characters. He was extremely annoyed that I processed a return, and he was made to come back and started curing me and COSTCO. He obviously had no option but to take the product back. When i asked him to provide a paperwork stating that the dishwasher was picked up he said the company is all electronic and does not provide paper receipts. I then asked him to send it then to my email. He then went on a political rant about how democrats have destroyed this country, republicans do not ask for such things. My point of view was what has an installation got to do with political beliefs. COSTCO needs to get their acts together and hire legitimate business to install their products. Since then, I purchased the same dishwasher from local vendor, and it got installed without any fuss.

Sentence (English): This is our first Bosch appliance.
Comments (English): [ Great purchase and experience ] || ---------------- || This is our first Bosch appliance. I'm not exaggerating when I say EVERY appliance sales and repair tech we have encountered in recent years has recommended this brand. When our dishwasher from another brand failed after only 5 years, we were so pleased to see that Costco had affordable options to finally try Bosch. We can't speak to the reliability or longevity yet, but in the few months we have had this new Bosch we are definitely impressed with the features. To say it is quiet is an understatement. It is virtually silent! The red light that shines from the bottom corner is the only indication it is running. The configuration inside is slightly different than what we have had in the past, specifically the utensil rack, but we are finding it is actually really convenient to load and easy to use. There are plenty of cycle settings and the cleaning results have been stellar. We have always opened the door of our dishwashers after a cycle is complete to allow for air drying. On this dishwasher, we simply pull the middle rack out slightly to prop the door open a bit. We have found that the dishes themselves and interior of the dishwasher are mostly dry before we do this and completely dry within a very short time after propping the door. Much faster and better than other brand dishwashers we have owned. We love the fact that there is no exposed heating element in the bottom so we don't have to worry about plastics melting in the bottom rack. Overall, this Bosch dishwasher has been a terrific upgrade from our previous dishwashers. As for delivery and installation, our experience was smooth, organized, and timely. I don't know if that was just specific to our area (mid-Michigan) or not but we did not have any problems at all, despite some reviewers mentioning issues with that. We did measure the space precisely so we knew the Bosch would fit (the installation scheduler mentioned that these dishwashers are very particular in their counter height requirements). We also purchased a Bosch junction box so we had that ready for the installer since our setup was direct wire and the Bosch comes as a plug in. Bottom line, so far has been a great entry level Bosch dishwasher with easy delivery/installation.

Bottom line, so far has been a great entry level Bosch dishwasher with easy delivery/installation.

Sentence (English): Purchased this free standing dishwasher from the big box store name and had no issues with the shop.
Comments (English): [ Don't waste your money ] || ---------------- || Purchased this free standing dishwasher from the big box store name and had no issues with the shop. On first day of installation and running the dishes came out wet after a cycle and that's even leaving gap after the drying cycle. After 3 months of running the machine I noticed the dishes getting wetter each time until one day it came out soaking wet like someone just had a shower in there and stepped out and the inner door panels was cold to the touch. Logged a repair with the big box store and a tech came out repaired the logic board but that was not the issue. Turns out it was a faulty temperature sensor hence it did not display any error codes. A week passed and the repair tech ordered the part and came out and replaced it. Ran another cycle but noticed my dishes was damp not dry bone as one would think a dishwasher would do and that's even with rinse aid added and the extra drying time was selected on the dishwasher as well. Racks an baskets still have water droplets on them and the lower rack for pots and pans constantly skips its track when you push it back in due to its small wheels. The middle rack cannot take anything larger than a small coffee cup or it would clash with the cutlery basket on the very top and that's with the basket being lowered. On the lower basket the mesh grid is so wide many oval shaped plates falls through the gaps and obstructs the lower spray bar which I have to constantly adjust the plates. Why is there so many issues. If I had a choice of buying another one I would stay well clear of this and go for something better. Trying to lodge a refund but big box store is pushing its right to repair on the technician and if they can't fix it they would have to wear the cost of replacement but puts me in between a hard rock and a tough situation as the product isn't doing what its supposed to be doing.

Sentence (English): I've owned numerous diswashers over the years including Kenmore, GE, Kitchenaid and most recent Maytag.
Comments (English): [ Excellent at cleaning! ] || ---------------- || I've owned numerous diswashers over the years including Kenmore, GE, Kitchenaid and most recent Maytag. All were descent performing machines but longevity and overall quality was not the best. Our Maytag lasted about 5 years before the control board quit. After reading many reviews I decided to give Bosch a try. The 800 series had the best features for the price. The first thing I noticed was how well made this machine is and very easy to install. The door latch works well and is easy to shut and open. There is plenty of room inside for large items and the top 3rd rack is so much better for silverware than the basket. The 1 hour cycle has been all we need to get perfctly clean dishes, and they are completely dry. Some people claim their dishes are wet, let me tell you they come out piping hot and dry as a bone. I like not having a heating element which are prone to failing. There are longer cycles but the 1 hour seems to work perfectly. The touch panel responds well and the best part you literally can't hear the machine running. In fact there is a red light that is projected on the floor to let you know it's running. We have been using it for a littel over a month and so far it's the best performing machine we have owned.

I would have thought about just a 6-person product ~~ After doing some research, I liked this product the best so I bought it. I heard that Frog Detergent was a good match for this product, so I bought it and used it, and it cleaned well and didn't cause stains. I tried using it with dishwashing detergent, but they said it couldn't be cleaned. It looked like it had been cleanly washed. Thinking back to when I used to wash dishes by hand, now it's heaven. It really saves time and even dries~~~ I understand why Aunt Shin Segi does it (). I'm just wondering why I bought it now when I should have bought it a long time ago. Don't even think about buying it, just buy it and use it. The quality of your life will change. I'm very, very satisfied.

While these items are cheap I expressed concerns that perhaps this is a fire hazard. Sentence (English): It was actually quite easy to install myself.
Comments (English): It was actually quite easy to install myself. The hardest part was removing the aging dishwasher that was there before. This dishwasher is extremely quiet and washes quite well. I had some greasy air fryer utensils and racks and it got them all clean whereas I usually have to presoak in the sink and then scrub a bit to get the grease off of it. One thing I need to get is a rinse agent. I've never used it before, but there's a tank that you can put it in as I do get spots, but I'm sure it's not the fault of the machine, as other dishwashers I've used in the past have always given me spots. It does have some cool features like steam drying and delayed start time. The only thing I don't like about it is the controls are under my countertop and not easy to see once you close the door. Once you hit the power button, the dishwasher lights up and then when you hit the start button it won't start until you close the door. But when you close the door you have no idea what stage it's on. If I ever buy another one, I'm going to have the controls on the door panel, not the top of the door. So far I really love this dishwasher.

This is hands-down the best dishwasher we have ever owned, in terms of the job it does, how quietly it does it, the cost of the appliance, its appearance and its features. We owned a dishwasher that was original to the home and lasted probably a few years before we bought the house and ran it daily for our family for 9 years. We bought a replacement, a non-Bosch brand, and it didn't get our dishes satisfactorily clean, and then the motor died a few months later. It was covered by the warranty, but when the repair guy said he owned a Bosch, we knew we needed to return it. The Bosch has been great. It's very quiet but cleans effectively. The only issue I had was with preprogramming the door to automatically open at the end of the cycle to aid in drying. The programming didn't stick, so instead of it defaulting to open, we have to push the button to activate this option each time. So no real hassle, but it's a feature that should work and would help with forgetfulness. If not for that fault, I would have given this machine five stars.

Sentence (English): After delivery, the 3rd-party technician, hired by Costco, refused to install it because our old dishwasher was connected directly to our house water line without a way to disconnect it from the water valve (but with a shut-off switch).
Comments (English): [ Great products, but TERRIBLE installer ] || ---------------- || After delivery, the 3rd-party technician, hired by Costco, refused to install it because our old dishwasher was connected directly to our house water line without a way to disconnect it from the water valve (but with a shut-off switch). I couldn't see the other end of the water line, but it must be with a standard end that connects to the dishwasher (becuase it's connected now). The technician insisted that I need to cut my water line and install a standard valve so that he can use the tube that came with the dishwasher. I believe it is a total waste of time and money if I need to call a plumber to install a new valve for the technician's convenience. He was so inflexible not coping with this slight variation of the water connection because I'm almost 100% sure that all he needed to do was to use the existing water tube to connect to the new dishwasher. Note that the dishwasher came with a bunch of connectors and adapters (in addition to the water tube itslef), which are for dealing with this kind of connection situation. So, why not use them if needed? The Costco customer service was also inflexible saying I need to follow the technician's recommendation due to liability concern (about potential water damage). But, after a while I found a supervisor who understands my situation and is finding ways to resolve this issue, so I'm hopeful, but it wasn't easy to persuade him to be flexible. In any case, I wasted a lot of time already with this installation issue, and I still have a dishwasher to be installed. Message to Costco: Your good reputation with great products and warranty is being ruined by this unnecessary service issues. I'd like you think about how to serve customers better without being too rigid about your policy. Thank you.

Sentence (English): The main reason why I bought this machine is because of the stainless steel interior.
Comments (English): [ If barebones are for you this DW is for you. ] || ---------------- || The main reason why I bought this machine is because of the stainless steel interior. I'm happy about that. What I don't like is the way the unit's lower rack is configured, the location of the flatware basket handle, the super sensitive control panel, the amount of water left on items after a normal cycle, and the way the lower rack is so easy to get off track. First the lower rack configuration. There is too much space between the rows of tines. I read the manufacturer's suggestions for loading but find there is too much wasted space between the items I load into the unit. Narrow items like a Corningware oblong dish won't stay in position even it laying on its side because there are too few tines to support it. The handle for the flatware basket essentially blocks two full spaces. While I like the look of the control panel, it is super sensitive and will activate with the slightest touch (of a hip or wrist). There is way more water left on items than my old, barely working unit (keep a dish towel handy because you will need it when unloading). I read the owner's manual and followed their recommendations, but it is still a problem. Lastly, LG is not kidding when they tell you to make sure you pull the lower rack straight out (perfectly straight out! ) otherwise the rack will fall of the tracks. Not too hard to put the rack back on the rails but the slightest variance from “straight out” will make it go awry. Overall, I'm not delighted with this purchase and am considering returning the item if I can't learn to live with its shortcomings.

Sentence (English): We eat at home, and my mom always does the dishes.
Comments (English): [ I highly recommend it as a gift for your parents :) ] || ---------------- || We eat at home, and my mom always does the dishes. Since we have three meals a day, it takes a long time. My mom says that standing for long periods of time washing dishes causes back and hand pain. I used to give her a hand massager. Come to think of it! I was thinking about getting a dishwasher. A friend who knows a bit about home appliances recommended Media Brand, so I searched and found out that it's a company that also does ODMs for major brands like Samsung and LG, and is widely distributed in China and Southeast Asia. The price is reasonable, and I thought the technology was quite good, so I decided to buy it. (The prices of major brands are also very expensive.) This was my first time using a dishwasher, and it was a whole new world. ^^ Since it's for 6 people, installation wasn't difficult or complicated. I read that for a 12-person dishwasher, you need to get a quote for space beforehand. I liked the ample tray capacity, and it cleanly removes grease and sauces. Since it dries with residual heat, there's no need for additional washing. It significantly reduces the time and water usage compared to regular dishwashing. It's quiet, so it's convenient to run it before bed. Most of all, my mother loves it, so I'm very proud. Comments (English): [ I highly recommend it as a gift for your parents :) ] || ---------------- || We eat at home, and my mother always does the dishes. Since we have so many meals, it takes a long time. My mother says her back and hands hurt from standing and washing dishes for so long. I used to give her a hand massager. Thinking about it, I realized I should get a dishwasher. A friend who knows a bit about home appliances recommended Media Brand. I searched and found out that the company also does ODM for major brands like Samsung and LG, and that it's widely distributed in China and Southeast Asia. It's reasonably priced, and I thought the technology was decent, so I decided to buy it. (Big brand names can be quite expensive, though.) This was my first time using a dishwasher, and it was a revelation. It's a six-person unit, so installation wasn't difficult or complicated. I read that for a 12-person unit, you need to get a quote for space beforehand. The ample tray capacity was great, and it cleanly removes grease and sauce stains. The residual heat dries the water, so there's no need for extra dishes. It also significantly reduces the time it takes to wash dishes. It definitely reduces water usage. It's quiet, so it's convenient to use before bed. Most of all, I'm so happy that my mother loves it. At first, she said the dishwasher wasn't good enough and had to wash extra dishes. Now, she just lets the dishwasher do it all. I guess this is what they mean when they say your quality of life has improved :). I highly recommend it.

Sentence (English): We're a dual-income newlywed couple, and we strictly divide the household chores.
Comments (English): [ Worrying only delays delivery. ] || ---------------- || We're a dual-income newlywed couple, and we strictly divide the household chores. My wife is responsible for the dishes, but it felt both pitiful and apologetic to see her come home from work and wash them, so we hired a dishwasher. Having lived abroad, I was familiar with media brands. Large domestic brands are more expensive than I expected, so using a dishwasher for the first time was a bit daunting. After ordering, receiving, and installing it, my wife absolutely loves it. It significantly reduces water usage, and it doesn't splatter everywhere, which is great. We only need to run the dishwasher once a day in the evening. (It's also quiet, so running it in the evening isn't a big deal.) In my experience, I found that dishwashing is crucial. Make sure to place dishes on a single level, avoiding overlapping. I recommend placing larger dishes (frying pans, pots) on the top shelf. Be careful, though, because improper placement can result in slightly under-cleaned dishes. Other than that, I'm very satisfied with the steam sterilization and grease removal effects. The biggest benefit is not having to stand all day with a sore back and neck while washing dishes. It's a huge improvement in my quality of life. The price is also good value for money, so I highly recommend you try it.
Comments (Original): [ 고민은 배송을 늦출뿐... ] || ---------------- || 저희는 맞벌이 신혼부부로 집안일은 철저히 분업을 합니다.설거지은 와이프 담당인데 힘들게 일하고 와서 설거지 하는 모습이안쓰럽고 미안하기도 해서 식세기 이모님을 모셨습니다.해외생활했던 경험이 있어서 미디어 브랜드는 익숙했어요국내 대기업 브랜드는 가격이 생각보다 높아서식세기 첫경험으로 사용하기에는 조금 부담스러웠습니다.주문하고 받아서 설치해보니 와이프가 정말 좋아해요물 사용도 엄청 줄어들고, 사방에 물이 튀지도 않아서 좋습니다.설거지 양은 하루에 한번 저녁에 돌리면 해결됩니다.(소음이 없어서 저녁에 돌려도 큰 문제 없습니다)실제로 사용해보니 식기 배치가 중요합니다, 한층으로 겹치지 않게 잘 배치하고최상단에는 큰 식기(후라이팬, 냄비)를 넣으시는걸 추천합니다.배치가 잘못되면 약간 덜 닦인상태로 나오는 경우도 있으니 주의하시구요.그 외에는 스팀 살균효과, 기름때 제거효과 등 만족합니다.사실 하루종일 서서 허리 아프고 목 아프게 설거지 안하는게가장 큰 장점이고 삶의 질이 확 달라집니다.가격도 가성비 있게 잘 나와서 꼭 경험해보시길 추천합니다.

Comments (English): [ I bought it while moving and am satisfied with it. ] || ---------------- || I bought it while moving and am satisfied with it. However, the installation process was not easy. Because it did not fit the size of the apartment sink, we first had to sell an artificial marble top in the shape of a ruler, and commissioned LG's partner company to do the construction. The consultation was quick and friendly, and the cutting engineer worked really hard, but when I tried to install the dishwasher, the angle of the cutting surface was not right, so the upper left part was scratched and barely fit. I was really upset that my new, expensive product got damaged, so I contacted the company and they asked me to tell them what kind of compensation I wanted. . In the end, I was informed that it was the company's policy to pay 50,000 won in compensation, and discussions were made to disclose the progress. It would be nice if all apartment sinks were designed to accommodate dishwasher installation, but if that is difficult, I hope that at least some good solution can be devised so that there are no more difficulties and blushes during the installation process. * It is simple because it is touch-operated, but if you open the door slightly, the button is pressed with a light touch. Although it is not as good as induction, it seems to be safer to use if the button is recognized only when some pressure is applied.

Sentence (English): After 8 months of daily use, the impressions are favorable.
Comments (English): [ Almost without objections ] || ---------------- || After 8 months of daily use, the impressions are favorable. If it was offered in the menu, I would choose a rating of 4.5. We most often use the Eco program 50°, if necessary fast (approximately 75 minutes, 65°) or the one for heavily soiled dishes, 70°. We praise: It is very quiet, the commands via the buttons are understandable and sufficient for everyday use. For gaming and exploring, there's also a WiFi connection with the HomeConnect function that allows personalization according to needs. The reminder that the machine needs to be cleaned (appears after a certain number of work cycles) is a useful detail. We are very satisfied with the quality of washing. Remark: Not very good drying of dishes, even with the option of additional drying. General impression: A quality-made device that is a pleasure to see and use.
Comments (Original): [ Skoro bez primedbi ] || ---------------- || Posle 8 meseci svakodnevnog koriščenja, utisci su povoljni. Za igranje i istraživanje, tu je i WiFi veza sa funkcijom HomeConnect koja omogućuje personalizaciju u skladu sa potrebama. Sentence (English): I bought it when I moved and I am using it with satisfaction.
Comments (English): I bought it when I moved and I am using it with satisfaction. However, the installation process was not easy. Since it did not fit the size of the apartment sink, I had to cut the artificial marble top into a square shape in advance, and I commissioned the construction to an LG partner company. The consultation was quick and friendly, and the cutting technician worked really hard, but when I tried to install the dishwasher, the angle of the cut surface was not right, so the upper left part was scratched and barely fit. I was really upset that my expensive new product was scratched, so I contacted the company and they asked me what kind of compensation I wanted. In the end, I was told that the company's policy was to pay 50,000 won in compensation, and the AS process was discussed to be made public. I wish all apartment sinks were designed to fit the dishwasher, but if that is difficult, I hope that some good solution is found so that there are no more awkward and embarrassing moments during the installation process. * It is convenient because it is a touch-type operation, but if the door is slightly open, the button is pressed with a light touch. I think it would be safer to use if the button was activated only when some pressure was applied, although not as much as induction.
Comments (Original): 이사하면서 구입했는데 만족하며 사용중입니다. 다만 설치과정은 쉽지 않았어요. 아파트 싱크대 사이즈에 맞지 않아서 인조대리석 상판을 ㄷ자 형태로 파는 작업을 선행했는데 시공은 엘지의 협력업체에  의뢰했습니다. 상담은 신속 친절했고 절단 기사님은 정말 열심히 작업해 주셨는데 막상 식세기를 설치하려니 절단면 각도가 맞지 않아서 왼쪽 윗부분이 드드득 긁히면서 간신히 끼어졌습니다. 고가의 새 제품에 상처가 나서 정말 속상한 마음에 업체에  연락했더니 어떤 보상을 원하는지 말해 보라네요..ㅎ..결국 보상금 5만원을 지급하는게 회사의 방침이라는 안내를 받았고 as 진행 과정은 공개하기로 얘기가 진행되었어요..모든 아파트 싱크대가 식세기 설치에 맞게 설계되면 좋겠지만 그게 어렵다면 적어도 설치과정에서 서로 곤란하고 얼굴 붉히는 일은 더 이상 발생하지 않도록 뭔가 좋은 방안이 마련되길 바랍니다. * 터치식 작동이라 간편하긴 한데 문을 살짝 열어놓으면 오다가다 가벼운 터치만으로도 버튼이 눌러지네요..인덕션만큼은 아니어도 뭔가 압력이 가해질 때만 버튼이 인식되면 좀더 안전하게 사용할 거 같네요.

We just got a new Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit 14-seater built-in dishwasher~~! We were originally using an SK dishwasher at home, but after using it for a few months, I could see some of its shortcomings. So I really wanted to change it, and then! A great opportunity arose, and I ended up replacing it with a Samsung dishwasher! The technician came to give me an installation estimate the day before the dishwasher installation. It took about 1 hour and 30 minutes to look at this and that, secure the space, etc. And the next day! He installed the dishwasher in the morning. Installation was done in 30 minutes! The dishwasher has three levels, with the bottom level designed for the largest dishes and pots. The second level is height-adjustable, so if you end up putting a really large pot in the bottom, you can raise the middle level to create more space. One of the advantages of this dishwasher is its quick wash mode. If you don't have a lot to wash, use this cycle. You only need to place dishes on the top level. It only takes 37 minutes! It's also incredibly quiet on night mode. Even if you leave it on at night and go to sleep, the door will automatically open, so there's no need to worry. I used the dishwasher the day after installation and loved it. It's designed for 14 people, so it definitely holds a lot of dishes. The dishwasher has a standing ceiling. When I was looking into dishwashers, I was told that a standing ceiling is important, so I checked. I heard that plastic ceilings tend to collect water, which is not good. I heard the dishwasher had incredible cleaning power, so I decided to give it a try. The door automatically opens when the dishwasher is finished, allowing it to dry! And then it air-dries, swoosh! The washed dishes were clean, despite having been caked on for days. More importantly, no matter how much detergent I use, the grease builds up, and I often have to rinse the dishes two or three times. But they felt incredibly crisp and clean. I'm so satisfied! When I first got a dryer, it was truly revolutionary, not an exaggeration. I thought my quality of life had truly improved. But in this modern world, one "aunt" wasn't enough. We just got a new Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit 14-seater built-in dishwasher~~! When I was looking into dishwashers, I was told that a standing ceiling is important, so I checked. I heard that plastic ceilings tend to collect water, which is not good. I heard the dishwasher had incredible cleaning power, so I decided to give it a try. The door automatically opens when the dishwasher is finished, allowing it to dry! And then it air-dries, swoosh! More importantly, no matter how much detergent I use, the grease builds up, and I often have to rinse the dishes two or three times. But they felt incredibly crisp and clean. I'm so satisfied! We just got a new Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit 14-seater built-in dishwasher~~! We were originally using an SK dishwasher at home, but after using it for a few months, I could see some of its shortcomings. So I really wanted to change it, and then! The second level is height-adjustable, so if you end up putting a really large pot in the bottom, you can raise the middle level to create more space. One of the advantages of this dishwasher is its quick wash mode. If you don't have a lot to wash, use this cycle. You only need to place dishes on the top level. It only takes 37 minutes! It's also incredibly quiet on night mode. Even if you leave it on at night and go to sleep, the door will automatically open, so there's no need to worry. I used the dishwasher the day after installation and loved it. It's designed for 14 people, so it definitely holds a lot of dishes. The dishwasher has a standing ceiling. When I was looking into dishwashers, I was told that a standing ceiling is important, so I checked. I heard that plastic ceilings tend to collect water, which is not good. I heard the dishwasher had incredible cleaning power, so I decided to give it a try. The door automatically opens when the dishwasher is finished, allowing it to dry! And then it air-dries, swoosh! More importantly, no matter how much detergent I use, the grease builds up, and I often have to rinse the dishes two or three times. But they felt incredibly crisp and clean. I'm so satisfied! When I first got a dryer, it was truly revolutionary, not an exaggeration. I thought my quality of life had truly improved. But in this modern world, one "aunt" wasn't enough. More importantly, no matter how much detergent I use, the grease builds up, and I often have to rinse the dishes two or three times. But they felt incredibly crisp and clean. I'm so satisfied! We just got a new Samsung Electronics BESPOKE Kitchen Fit 14-seater built-in dishwasher~~! We were originally using an SK dishwasher at home, but after using it for a few months, I could see some of its shortcomings. So I really wanted to change it, and then! A great opportunity arose, and I ended up replacing it with a Samsung dishwasher! The technician came to give me an installation estimate the day before the dishwasher installation. It took about 1 hour and 30 minutes to look at this and that, secure the space, etc. And the next day! He installed the dishwasher in the morning. Installation was done in 30 minutes! The dishwasher has three levels, with the bottom level designed for the largest dishes and pots. The second level is height-adjustable, so if you end up putting a really large pot in the bottom, you can raise the middle level to create more space. One of the advantages of this dishwasher is its quick wash mode. If you don't have a lot to wash, use this cycle. You only need to place dishes on the top level. It only takes 37 minutes! It's also incredibly quiet on night mode. Even if you leave it on at night and go to sleep, the door will automatically open, so there's no need to worry. I used the dishwasher the day after installation and loved it. It's designed for 14 people, so it definitely holds a lot of dishes. The dishwasher has a standing ceiling. When I was looking into dishwashers, I was told that a standing ceiling is important, so I checked. I heard that plastic ceilings tend to collect water, which is not good. I heard the dishwasher had incredible cleaning power, so I decided to give it a try. The door automatically opens when the dishwasher is finished, allowing it to dry! And then it air-dries, swoosh! The washed dishes were clean, despite having been caked on for days. More importantly, no matter how much detergent I use, the grease builds up, and I often have to rinse the dishes two or three times. But they felt incredibly crisp and clean. I'm so satisfied! When I first got a dryer, it was truly revolutionary, not an exaggeration. I thought my quality of life had truly improved. But in this modern world, one "aunt" wasn't enough. If I had to buy this again I would not buy it and spend a little more and get a better dishwasher.

Sentence (English): My previous built-in dishwasher broke, so I bought this in a hurry.
Comments (English): [ I'm very satisfied! ] || ---------------- || My previous built-in dishwasher broke, so I bought this in a hurry. It's a 12-person unit, and for around 400,000 won, it even has an automatic door opener! The price is unbelievable. The silver color is sleek, it washes well, and when I open it, it sparkles and feels refreshing! Even on the standard cycle, it's much faster than just running the bottom of my previous dishwasher. There's an economy mode, but the manual doesn't clearly state whether it's just the top or bottom load or what it's supposed to save. Since it's about a 4-minute difference in the time between the economy mode and the standard mode, I'm just using it for smaller loads. I also use a media washer and dryer, so I wasn't worried about buying it. It's faithful to the basics, with no unnecessary frills. The price is the best part: if it breaks, I can just buy another one.
Comments (Original): [ 대만족이에요! ] || ---------------- || 전에 쓰던 빌트인 식기세척기가 고장나서 급하게 구입했어요. 12인용인데 40만원대에 자동문열림까지 되다니!!! 믿을 수 없는 가격 최고최고 실버 색상 깔끔하구요, 세척 잘되고, 열어보면 뽀득뽀득 반짝반짝 속이 시원합니다! 표준 코스로 돌려도 전에 쓰던 식기세척기반만 돌리는 것 보다 훨씬 빨리 끝나요. 절약모드가 있긴 한데, 상단 또는 하단만 돌리는 건지 뭘 절약한다는 건지 설명서에 명확하게 나와있진 않네요. 절약모드랑 소요시간 4분 차이나서 양이 적어도 그냥 표준모드로 사용하고 있어요. 저는 세탁 건조기도 미디어 쓰고 있어서 별 걱정 안하고 구입했어요. 쓸데없는 군더더기 없이 기본에 충실합니다. 고장나면 다시 하나 또 사도 될 정도의 가격이 최고의 장점입니다.

Sentence (English): Just retired from the military with 27 years served.
Comments (English): [ A Let Down, For Sure ] || ---------------- || Just retired from the military with 27 years served. Bought a home in my home town and the old dishwasher stopped working with in a month. I purchased the Bosch Ascenta from a local appliance store for $550, $100 for delivery and $120 for install ($770 not counting tax). This was my first Bosch appliance and was expecting top notch. moving in the military over 12 homes in 27 years, I have seen good and bad dishwashers. For the Ascenta the good thing is that 1) It cleans the dishes. 2) You can set a timer. 3) It's fairly quiet. The bad? 1) Water is left everywhere, on the doors, the walls, and the bottom of the dishwasher. 2) The dishwasher stinks all the time except for right after the cycle. Twenty to thirty minutes later it smells awful, until you run it again. I live in a humid environment so it makes it even worse. The door cannot be cracked open because it automatically shuts. The local appliance store I purchased from told me to add a scented detergent. it's a Bosch, should I need to add anything but detergent? 3) You have to manually turn of the dishwasher or it keeps flashing at you. This is not the end of the world but come on. 4) You need to add a rinsing agent. For this price and it being a Bosch, I'm surprised I need to add anything but detergent. We reached out to the appliance store and they mentioned giving us 85% of our product funds back to put towards another appliance but would charge us the $100 delivery fee and the $120 intall fee. So, if you want to have to add detergent, rinse aid, scent and track the exact time your dishwasher cycle is over. then wipe down water on the inside every time you use it. this dishwasher is for you.

Comments (English): Wow, wow, I can't tell you how much I've been waiting for the dishwasher to finally arrive. Otherwise, it is really a great dishwasher, and a real upgrade from what we had before.

The utensil rack is all the way in the back of the lower rack, so you have to pull the lower rack all the way open to load:unload it. I do like the fact that you can use or not use the utensil separator by lifting the top. The one hour wash:dry works well & dishes are clean. I attempted to call Bosch to obtain the correct toe panel so that I can complete the installation and I was unable to do so. As you can see in my photo, the only option is to bind the rubber apron to the unit with the slotted toe panel (included in part number ********), even though the installation instructions say "If your model has a rubber apron, open the door to make sure that the apron is in the correct position. Ensure the apron does not bind up and can freely move up and down behind the toe panel." The other photo shows the standard toe panel in the instructions. If this model does not include the rubber apron, but one was installed at the factory in my unit contrary to the specifications, it raises questions about what other manuafacturing defects may have occurred that I cannot see. Additionally, the plastic silver accent strip above the handle is not firmly attached. It is quite flimsy and moves around when touched, which happens frequently because it is right above the handle used to open the door of the dishwasher. Overall, I find myself quite disappointed with what is supposed to be Bosch's "Benchmark" dishwasher. I have spent a lot of time calling Bosch and the store from which I purchased this dishwasher, and I find myself no closer to a resolution.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher only works as long as the buttons on the front work.
Comments (English): [ Function buttons DO NOT WORK ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher only works as long as the buttons on the front work. From day one, The buttons were very difficult to push and they stopped working all together within The first month only running it once per week for just my husband and I. A warranty service call was done and the repair person said we were not the only people having trouble with the buttons on this model and he replaced something on the inside of the top of the door behind the buttons and within another month, the buttons became very very difficult to push again because they either don't reach the circuitry in the top of the door to change the cycle or start the dishwasher, or the inner component is failing in someway or another. It is awful to have a virtually brand new dishwasher, that you cannot change the runtime or the cycle or start it without struggling to push the buttons and then having them fail all together. Even the store that we purchased this unit brand new from, on two different visits to two different Lowes locations, speaking to two different salespersons, stated the same thing, that this model has problems with the function buttons being very difficult to use and many of them get returned and the ones that do not, they end up hearing the buyers describe the same regretful and exact same experience. One of them suggested that this was probably going to be a class action lawsuit if no recall event occurred in the near future to replace the circuitry board after a functional redesign was implemented for the buttons, so we should keep checking back on this model status, but to date, a year and a half later, we still have a dysfunctional dishwasher that has been run less than 25 times total.

It is awful to have a virtually brand new dishwasher, that you cannot change the runtime or the cycle or start it  without struggling to push the buttons and then having them fail all together.  Even the store that we purchased this unit brand new from, on two different visits to two different Lowes locations, speaking to two different salespersons, stated the same thing, that this model has problems with the function buttons being very difficult to use and many of them get returned and the ones that do not, they end up hearing the buyers describe the same regretful and exact same experience.  One of them suggested that this was probably going to be a class action lawsuit if no recall event occurred in the near future to replace the circuitry board after a functional redesign was implemented for the buttons, so we should keep checking back on this model status, but to date, a year and a half later, we still have a dysfunctional dishwasher that has been run less than 25 times total.
